steps.caption: Open Deal toolkit from the sidebar.
Pick the client search — Zentrix, 25,000 sf in Kharadi.
The score card: how many items are confirmed, estimated or still missing.
Ask the client next: the must-have questions still open, most important first.
Sections A–G: client, space, location, budget, timeline, approvals and gaps.
Each value shows its status. The size range here is an estimate until the client confirms.
Fill these in opens the missing items of a section so you can type them straight in.
Assumptions & open questions sums up confirmed, estimated, assumed and missing items, plus pending approvals.
Brief snapshots lists every saved version; Meeting outcomes shows what was agreed in meetings.
Open requirement goes to the client's requirement record behind this brief.
Save a snapshot — a fixed version you can approve and use in client documents.
Saved. It lists the mandatory items still missing before it can be approved.
The step bar: fill the gaps, save a snapshot, approve it, then use it in client documents.
Download deck makes an editable PowerPoint of the brief.
